analogy.rationale: Tricyclic antidepressants block SLC6A2/SLC6A4 monoamine transporters and muscarinic/adrenergic receptors, so SSRIs, norepinephrine reuptake/transporter inhibitors, and adrenergic or muscarinic antagonists should share the most transcriptional similarity; however, these cell lines express little of the neuronal monoamine machinery, so the overall response is expected to be weak.
